name: funding_scan
description: Rank current funding with estimated net APY for a hold period. Returns bounded executable/anywhere views, counts, failures and unmatched markets. Annualization is simple, not compounded. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

sizeUsd.description: Positive USD size. Defaults to default_size_usd config or 1000.

market.description: Normalized base ticker; omit to scan all markets.

venues.description: Venue IDs: hl, lighter, lighter-mainnet, aster, binance, bybit, okx, mexc, bingx, bitget, gate, grvt, variational, qfex. Omit for all.

topExec.description: Positive integer limit for executable view; default 5, cap 200.

top.description: Positive integer limit for anywhere view, or executable-only view; default 10, cap 200.

allPairs.description: Include every pair instead of the best per base in each view.

executable.description: Only the executable view, limited by top.

minApy.description: Minimum gross simple annualized spread percentage; not the net APY filter.

minVolume24hUsd.description: Nonnegative minimum known USD volume per leg; default 1000000.

includeThin.description: Include below-threshold or unknown-volume pairs in the views.

includeCrossDeployment.description: Include Lighter cross-deployment pairs in the executable view; default false.

holdDays.description: Positive hold horizon in days for fee amortization; default 7.

includeFull.description: Include the full opportunities array; can exceed 3 MB. Default false keeps only counts and bounded views.

name: funding_rates
description: Read filtered native-market funding observations with hourly and simple annualized rates and snapshot metadata. At least one of venue or market is required; raw rates and listings follow the same filter as the view. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

venue.description: Venue ID; omit for all venues.

market.description: Normalized base ticker; omit for all markets.

name: funding_history
description: Read settled keyless funding history, interval-weighted averages, coverage, and the best average spread. Lighter has no keyless history. Annualization is simple, not compounded. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

base.description: Required normalized base ticker, for example BTC or PEPE.

venues.description: Venue IDs: hl, lighter, lighter-mainnet, aster, binance, bybit, okx, mexc, bingx, bitget, gate, grvt, variational, qfex. Omit for all.

name: explain
description: Read bundled Markdown about funding, basis, fees, and MoB protection. Omit topic to list topics. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

topic.description: Bundled topic name, such as funding, annualization, or liquidation-protection.

simple.description: Return the plain-language Simple section only.

name: task_list
description: Read public tasks for an owner. Funding accrued is an estimate. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

owner.description: Public 20-byte 0x owner address. Defaults to the owner config key.

name: task_get
description: Read one public task and optional trim/resize logs. Funding accrued is an estimate. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

owner.description: Public 20-byte 0x owner address. Defaults to the owner config key.

name: config_get
description: Read a local setting: api_base, strategy_api_base, owner, default_size_usd, taker_fee_bps.<venue>, builder_fee_tenths_bps, signer, or policy. No setting is changed. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

name: onboarding_status
description: Read the onboarding checklist: legal acceptance, venue readiness, safe key prefix and verification state. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

owner.description: Public 20-byte 0x owner address. Defaults to the owner config key.

venues.description: Trade venue IDs: hl, lighter, lighter-mainnet, aster. Omit for all.

name: key_status
description: Read the local key prefix, storage backend and live verification result. The secret is never returned. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

name: propose_open
description: Stage an open using native venue:market legs and fresh marks. Protection requires assumed leverage; it does not set venue leverage. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

long.description: Native long leg, for example hl:BTC or hl:xyz:NVDA.

short.description: Native short leg, for example lighter:BTC or aster:USD1:BTC.

sizeUsd.description: Required positive USD size per leg, supplied by the human.

assumeLeverage.description: Required with protection: L or L,S, each >= 1. Assumed leverage, not verified on the venue.

minApy.description: Nonnegative simple annualized funding APY threshold; default 0.

maxSpreadBps.description: Positive entry spread cap in bps; default 50.

name: propose_close
description: Stage close for one owned task. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

name: propose_neutralize
description: Stage neutralize for one owned task. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

name: propose_resize
description: Stage new base amounts for a running task, quantized toward its current sizes. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

short.description: New short base amount; positive. Supply at least one leg.

name: propose_protect
description: Stage protection for a running task. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

name: propose_auto_close
description: Stage auto-close for a running task. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

minApy.description: Nonnegative simple annualized funding APY threshold; default 0.

name: propose_size_mismatch_close
description: Stage size mismatch auto-close for a running task. Stages one local Proposal and stops. Never signs, submits, or holds keys. Requires configured owner, signer, and manual policy.

enabled.description: Enable or disable size mismatch auto-close.

pct.description: Required threshold percentage, 0.5 through 100, including when disabling.

name: proposal_list
description: Read local Proposal views, including their stored preflight results. Does not refresh or authorize them. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.

name: proposal_get
description: Read one local Proposal view with its exact message, digest, expiry, body, and stored preflight. Does not refresh or authorize it. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, imports, submits, or reveals a key.
